triage_state: PARTIEL — contextual qualification, no global security clearance
scope: Application-security/documentary triage of preserved scan evidence and observed development constraints; no infrastructure hardening, package change, suppression or scanner reconfiguration

scanner.name: Trivy
scanner.default_cache_warning: The separately displayed default cache dated September11 was not used for these results; explicit cache metadata above is authoritative

counting_notes: Occurrences count package/advisory pairs in targets, not proven exploit paths.
Identifiers may be CVE, GHSA or TEMP. Aliases were not fully normalized, so unique_advisory_ids is not a certified count of distinct vulnerabilities.
Repeated IDs in binary subpackages or uv/uvx are not discarded as false positives. All original findings remain.

priorities.reason: Residual HIGH/CRITICAL findings and incomplete reachability qualification; local fictional-data lab only.
Use application test evidence separately; passing functional tests does not clear image vulnerabilities.
Review vendor fix/support and threat model; architecture/image hardening belongs to Mathias and is not automatically implemented.

reachability.evidence: The scan lists the components. No supplied business route intentionally invokes mount helpers. This is a code-based inference, not a penetration test or proof that a compromised process cannot reach them.
reachability.corrective_criterion: Review each applicable vendor advisory, image update compatibility and privileges before any real exposure.

reachability.evidence: All185 recorded occurrences are class os-pkgs. Absence of language-package findings in this report is not an exhaustive security proof.

sources.observation: util-linux2.41.5 Debian trixie is listed vulnerable; fixes in other suites do not prove this image corrected.

limits: No penetration test, exhaustive call graph, load/Internet qualification or certification.
No package/advisory removed because a service is inactive or an exploit precondition was not observed.
No operating-system upgrade, firewall change, deployment, backup/restore or learner exercise performed by this triage.
Application tests are Codex preparation; no personal learner level is assigned.

review_validation.method: Independent recount from existing raw scanner JSON and hash comparison to the unchanged published historical summary; no scan rerun or runtime mutation.
review_validation.origin: Codex documentary preparation; no learner competence or infrastructure acceptance assigned
